hypothesis: Rotating the block owner by one lane on each row-group wave changes which rows each block processes while retaining balanced group counts. It may change inter-block GM access scheduling; no performance benefit is assumed without device measurements.
change: For rowCount == 128 and rowWidth == 16384 in ProcessWideLowPrecision, use group width 2 when blockCount <= 64 and width 1 otherwise. For local group ordinal t, map block j to global group t * blockCount + (j + t) % blockCount. Compute the partial-tail group count from the same phase-shifted owner formula. Input loads, prefetched loads, and output stores use the same row mapping. Other shapes retain GetBalancedRowRange. Arithmetic, tile sizes, UB buffers, and reduction logic are unchanged.

ownership_validation.command: node -e 'const n=128;let nonEquivalent=0;for(let b=1;b<=n;b++){const g=b<=64?2:1,m=n/g,q=Math.floor(m/b),r=m%b,seen=new Uint8Array(n),loads=[];for(let j=0;j<b;j++){const newGroups=q+(((j+q)%b)<r?1:0),oldGroups=q+(j<r?1:0),newRows=[],oldRows=[];for(let k=0;k<newGroups;k++){const group=k*b+((j+k)%b);for(let lane=0;lane<g;lane++){const row=group*g+lane;if(row>=n||seen[row])throw Error(`invalid b=${b} row=${row}`);seen[row]=1;newRows.push(row);}}for(let k=0;k<oldGroups;k++)for(let lane=0;lane<g;lane++)oldRows.push((k*b+j)*g+lane);loads.push(newRows.length);if(newRows.length!==oldRows.length||newRows.some((x,i)=>x!==oldRows[i]))nonEquivalent++;}if(seen.some(x=>x!==1))throw Error(`gap b=${b}`);if(Math.max(...loads)-Math.min(...loads)>g||Math.min(...loads)<1)throw Error(`balance b=${b}`)}if(nonEquivalent<1)throw Error("no per-block mapping difference from R051");console.log(`phase-rotated mapping: N=128, B=1..128, coverage/uniqueness/nonempty/balance PASS; per-block assignments differ from R051 in ${nonEquivalent} cases`)'
ownership_validation.raw_output: phase-rotated mapping: N=128, B=1..128, coverage/uniqueness/nonempty/balance PASS; per-block assignments differ from R051 in 3133 cases
invariants: For every tested blockCount, row groups cover [0, 128) exactly once with no out-of-range rows.
Every block receives at least one group for the supported 1 <= blockCount <= 128 range.
Per-block row counts differ by at most the configured group width (two rows for blockCount <= 64; one row otherwise).
The block-to-row assignment differs from R051's fixed group-cyclic mapping for non-degenerate multi-wave cases.
ownership_validation.scope_note: Static mapping validation only; not runtime correctness, physical-core behavior, or performance validation.
